headline: Per-share earnings hold up and far exceed last year
summary_short: EPS was IDR 39.53, up 1.2% from IDR 39.05 in the prior quarter and up 66.7% from IDR 23.71 a year earlier.
summary_long: Only the per-share earnings figure is available on the shard. It was roughly stable q/q and rose 66.7% y/y. No revenue, margin or cash figures were available from the shard, and no drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Two web searches found only first-half 2026 results and the nine-month 2025 comparison. EPS is Yahoo data.
